faqs.question: What are the parameters that will be tested during NIFT 2026 Personal Interview (PI)?
faqs.answer: PG candidates will be evaluated on the various parameters as listed below by a panel, in the Personal Interview: Career orientation Aptness for the course Overall personal achievements in academics and co-curricular activities Communication General awareness, aptitude, creative and lateral thinking Candidates will be shortlisted for the PI based on their performance in the written exam - GAT (and CAT in case of M.Des program). Please note that NIFT reserves the right to modify the entrance examination scheme. This includes non-conduct of any stage (s) due to unforeseen circumstances.

faqs.question: What is the syllabus for the NIFT Personal Interview?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to the Master's courses at NIFT participating need to appear in a Personal Interview after qualifying in NIFT written exam. Personal Interview is conducted in an offline mode. The interview will evaluate the candidate on the parameters like Career orientation, Aptness for the course, Overall personal achievements in academics and co-curricular activities, Communication, General awareness and aptitude, creative and lateral thinking. Note that the Personal Interview carries 30% weightage.

faqs.question: What is the syllabus for NIFT situation test?
faqs.answer: Situation Test carries 20 percent weightage. It will be a hands-on test and will check candidate's material handling and innovative ability. Candidate will be asked to make a model or design using a given set of materials. Expert panel with check the model on parameters like space visualization, innovative and creative use of given material, composition of elements, color scheme, construction skill, finesse of the model and overall presentation, etc. Candidate will also have to submit a write up explaining the model. The dates for NIFT stage 2 have not been announced yet.

faqs.question: What is NIFT 2025 exam pattern for the B.FTech program?
faqs.answer: The participating institutes of NIFTs offer a 4-year B.FTech programme. Admission to the programme is based on GAT scores. The NIFT 2025 GAT question paper for the programme will be of 180 minutes and will be bilingual. Candidates will have the option to take the exam either in English or Hindi. The question type will be multiple-choice. The question paper will have a total of 150 questions. Questions will be asked from the following FIVE sections - Communication Ability and Comprehension, Case Study, Quantitative Ability, Analytical & Logical Ability, and GK and Current Affairs. The mode of NIFT 2025 exam for the GAT paper will be computer-based-test (or CBT).

faqs.question: What is the exam pattern for the NIFT CAT paper?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to the B. Des and M.Des course also need to take the Creative Ability Test CAT written exam, in addition to the GAT. The CAT exam will be conducted in an offline, pen-pencil mode. CAT will be a drawing-based exam of 3 hours duration. The CAT will evaluate various skills of the candidate including Intuition skill, power of observation, innovation in the development of a concept as well as design ability. Further, it will examine the creative as well as innovative use of color and illustration skills of aspirants. It is mandatory for B. Des and M.Des candidates to appear in the CAT paper, or else they will not be invited for the Situation Test.

faqs.question: Do we need to join coaching to prepare for NIFT entrance exam?
faqs.answer:
Joining a coaching for NIFT preparation is not really needed. Coaching is for those who want to learn how to draw things. But, if someone has this talent, which most students passionate about sketching and painting do possess, there is no need for coaching. One can prepare through self-study.
For your understanding, I would like to give an example.
In coaching, students are made to learn how to draw the 3D image by various techniques using measuring instruments but one who is natural at art can imagine what 3D image would look like if it has to be drawn on a paper and would draw the same.
In both cases, the outcome is the same.
Regarding theory, that is, GAT, if you are confident to solve Maths, History, Geography, General science up till class 10th level, then there is definitely no need for coaching. Though the level of English is a bit high you can improve it yourself.

faqs.question: How many questions are asked in NIFT GAT?
faqs.answer: The exam pattern for NIFT GAT varies from one course to another. The total number of questions asked in NIFT GAT is mentioned below: BDes: 100 questions, BFTech: 150 questions, MDes: 120 questions, MFTech: 150 questions, MFM: 150 questions. Note that the GAT or the General Ability Test will be conducted in a computer-based mode. Questions will be objective-type. The GAT paper for the B. Des and M.Des programs will be of 120 minutes. However, the GAT paper for the B.FTech, M.FTech, and MFM courses will be for 180 minutes.

faqs.question: Will NTA share information entered by candidates during NIFT application submission with 3rd party?
faqs.answer: NTA/NIFT /Government of India can use the data provided by candidate for internal purpose(s) including training, research and development, analysis and other permissible purpose(s). However, this information will not be shared with any third party or private agency for any other use.

faqs.question: Can I carry my own material for the NIFT Situation Test?
faqs.answer: The NIFT Situation Test is a hands-on test that B. Des candidates need to appear in after qualifying the written exam. During the Situation Test the candidate has to make a model. Note that the material for making the model will be provided to the candidate inside the exam hall; no other material expect that provided to the candidate is allowed. So, candidates appearing in the Situation Test must not bring any additional materials for the Situation Test. The Situation Test will be evaluated on the spot. It is mandatory for the candidate to draft a write-up explaining the model.

faqs.question: What happens after the NIFT Situation Test/ Studio Test and/or Personal Interview?

faqs.answer: During the Situation Test, the candidate will be provided with a set of materials. Using these materials, the candidate will be required to make specific models. After completing the mode, the candidate will also have to draft a write-up, which is evaluated by the jury later. Note that besides material exploration & management skills, NIFT also lays great emphasis on time management skills and students are closely monitored on the fact that whether they have managed to complete the task at hand in two hours or not.

Admission under lateral entry scheme will be strictly on merit of NIFT 2026 exam, which will include written examination, studio test/ technology aptitude test, and a personal interview. faqs.answer: As per Section 2(t) of the RPwD Act, “Persons with Disability (PwD)” means a person with long-term physical, mental, intellectual, or sensory impairment which, in interaction with barriers, hinders his full and effective participation in society equally with others.

Special Tips to prepare for NIFT (CAT) Creative Ability Test 2026

NIFT CAT is a paper-pencil-based test for three hours. In NIFT CAT, aspirants are given three to four subjective questions wherein they need to draw/ make sketches and answer the questions put forth to them.
The CAT test for the B.Des program carries 50% weightage and is the most important component of the entrance test.
Step-wise preparation tips for NIFT CAT :

value: Inspiration and creativity - The candidate must develop the skill of minutely observing things and situations and must take a mental image of them. This kind of exercise will help with memory drawings. Keen observation will also help the candidate to understand the dynamics of various elements in a setting and the interplay between them. This, in turn, will not only inspire the candidate but also open the floodgates of creativity!
Geometrical Shapes - The world we live in is filled with items of various geometrical shapes. Learn to draw various geometrical shapes one at a time till you master all of them.

Concept Development - Before starting to craft a drawing, the conceptualization process must be dealt with first. Identify what you are going to draw, what components and elements you are going to use, and why. The candidate is urged to work on their observation and visualization skills. Visualization skill in the sense that you must be able to foretell how the drawing would look, the story it is going to tell, etc.

Principles of Composition - In this type of drawing, the student can practice combining or arranging different elements and create different compositions. Note that the NIFT exam may ask the candidate to draw a particular sequence, and the practice of composition drawing will come in handy in such cases.

Product Drawing - Product drawing is the 2D representation of 3-dimensional objects. Products can be anything, be it your tiffin box, shoes, spectacles, t-shirt, or washing machine. Draw sketches of as many products as you can, as it will help you tackle any product-drawing-related question asked in the exam.
Poster Drawing - Make a list of all the trending topics and make poster drawings for each one of these topics.

Shading - Learn the various elements of shading, including reflected light, full light, case shadow, halftone, and shadow edge. If you master the art of shading, you can add the illusion of form, shape, and light to your drawings.
Coloring - Once the student has learned the A, B, and C of coloring, he or she can start playing around with different colors.
Human figures - The subject of your human figures could be a relative, a friend, a rickshaw puller, an ice cream seller, a school security person, an old and wrinkly-looking old woman, etc.

blocks.value: The NIFT Situation Test will evaluate the candidate on the following parameters: Concept development, which evaluates how one has answered the main subject of the question while remaining creative at its core. Whether the candidate is able to beautifully and intelligently convert the concept into a design/ product? How real-life is the 3D model? How much innovation is required to create the model. The amount of material exploration, experimentation and treatment given to otherwise simple craft raw material. Is the student able to explain the concept in the write up. If the student able to combine different types of materials considering their texture and weight. If the materials usage appropriate. Whether the student is able to utilise the resources not only in variety but also in quantity, that is, managing the limited supply.

To prepare for the NIFT 2026 Situation Test, the candidate needs to practice material handling. The candidate must be using different types of material like clay, aluminum foil, aluminum sheet, sun pack, foam, straw pipe, mouldable aluminium wire, etc. Practice cutting and attaching the material to make different types of models. When making a model, use a timer, because this way you will lean time-management and you brain will also start processing information accordingly. If you are getting stuck in your preparation, don't hesitate to take the help of peer, mentor, or your teacher.

Along with going through the textbooks and solving problem sets, candidates must also solve previous years question papers to prepare for NIFT 2026. One of the main benefits of solving sample papers is that candidate will get to know the difficulty level, types of questions asked, and marking scheme. By analyzing the previous years question papers, candidate may also figure out trends that are followed in drafting question.

blocks.value: What is NIFT Entrance Exam?

NIFT is a national-level design entrance exam conducted by the National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT) . The NIFTEE exam includes written exams comprising the NIFT GAT (General Ability Test) and NIFT CAT (Creative Ability Test) . The GAT paper is mandatory for all programs, while only B.Des and M.Des candidates need to take the CAT. NIFT Situation Test / Personal Interview is for B.Des candidates. Shortlisted candidates have to appear in the Situation Test, whereas PG candidates need to appear in a Personal Interview. Admission to the B.F.Tech program will be based on GAT scores.
NIFT Test for UG programmes
NIFT UG comprises B.Des and B.F. Tech
NIFT Test for PG programmes
NIFT PG comprises M.F.M, M.Des and M.F.Tech:

The final score of NIFT 2026 for the other programs will be prepared by giving weightage to the written exams and Situation Test/ Personal Interview. The scores or merit rank of NIFT will be considered for admission to design courses offered by the NIFT participating institutes . Currently, there are 19 participating institutes. The institutes offer the following courses - B.Des, M.Des, B.F.Tech, M.F.Tech, and M.F.M. Admission to these courses will be based on NIFT merit rank.

National Institute of Fashion Technology also allows candidates the option of direct admission to the 3rd semester of a UG program. Interested candidates may apply for NIFT Lateral Entry Admission 2026 .

faqs.question: Will NTA release the carbon copy of the OMR answer sheet for NIFT 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes, the NTA will upload the carbon copy of the OMR answer sheet along with the answer key. faqs.question: How can I raise objections against NIFT answer key?
faqs.answer: The NIFT answer key objection window will close once the draft key is released. To submit objections, you have to: Go to the NTA NIFT admission portal Click on the objection submission link A log-in window will open Log in using candidate credentials Once you log in, you can access the objection form Enter you roll number, date of birth, program, and question booklet series Select the answer key you want to challengeSelect the Question number Attach the supporting documents and describe your observation in concise and clear terms Make the payment of INR 200 per objection (note, the fee is non-refundable) Once you are done, submit the application.

faqs.question: Can I challenge the final NIFT 2026 answer key?
faqs.answer: NTA will release the FINAL answer key of NIFT 2026 in April 2026. Final key will be released after considering complaints filed by candidates against the provisional key. No further objections against the final key will be entertained. This means the keys given in the final key will be considered to be the correct keys to all the questions asked in the NIFT exam. The candidate can use the keys given in the final answer key to precisely calculate their expected scores.

faqs.question: Which level of NIFT is the hardest?
faqs.answer: NIFT Entrance Exam consists of NIFT Written exam: GAT and CAT. After this, the second stage is NIFT Situation Test and Personal Interview. NIFT CAT is said to be the hardest and most time taking in the first stage. In the second stage, NIFT Situation test is considered to be hard. But all these can be cleared with practice.

faqs.question: What should I do if there are any discrepancies in the NIFT 2026 admit card?
faqs.answer: Candidate must check all the details carefully after downloading the NIFT admit card 2026. This includes checking the spelling of your name, date and timings of the exam, name and address of the allotted exam centre, etc. In case there are any discrepancies, like your name's spelling is wrong , you must contact exam officials immediately. NIFT officials in most cases also issues a helpline for students to tackle such cases. You can call NIFT officials at this number or email them to get things sorted. Given the sensitivity of the matter, it is important that you don't wait for until too late to get the admit card issue resolved.

faqs.question: What if candidate is deemed ineligible by the NTA/ NIFT?
faqs.answer: In the event of any ineligibility being detected by NIFT /NTA at any stage of the NIFT admission process, the candidature of the candidate will be cancelled. Further, legal action also may be initiated. NTA will not verify the information provided by the candidates during online registration and hence candidature will be purely provisional subject to the fulfillment of eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for NIFT 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates applying for B. Des course need to have passed 10+2 exam from a recognised institute and should be less than 24 years as of August 1, 2026. Relaxation of 5 years in the upper age limit applies for candidates belonging to SC, ST and PwD categories.

faqs.question: When do I need to start my preparation for NIFT 2026 exam?
faqs.answer: The NIFT exam is among the competitive and is also considered among the toughest. So, it is recommended that the candidate starts their exam preparation early. NIFT exam has various components like written exam and Situation Test /Personal Interview. Candidates seeking admission to the B. Des and M.Des courses need to prepare for both the CAT and GAT. The CAT is a drawing-based exam. Now unless the candidate is already well-versed, the exam will be very difficult. So, start early. The same goes for the GAT.

faqs.question: What are the dos and don'ts for the NIFT CAT exam?
faqs.answer: The NIFT CAT exam will be administered in an offline mode and will be a drawing-based exam. During the course of the exam, the candidate is not allowed to write any personal details and place identification marks. The CAT exam will evaluate the candidate on parameters like intuitive ability, power of observation in concept development, and design ability. To prepare for the CAT the candidate needs to work on geometrical shapes, product drawing, line quality, shading, human figures, principles of composition, etc. To improve ones figure drawing skills, one may stick drawing, before moving on to block drawing, and then evolving to add clothes and other items.

faqs.question: What is the NIFT GAT exam pattern for the M.Des program?
faqs.answer: NIFT GAT paper for the M.Des programme include 120 multiple choice questions . The time given for GAT will be 120 minutes. The questions will be set in English and Hindi. Questions will be asked from Communication Ability, English Comprehension, Quantitative Ability, Analytical Ability, and GK and Current Affairs. The Communication Ability, English Comprehension, and Quantitative Ability sections will each include 30 questions, whereas Analytical Ability will have 20 questions, and GK and Current Affairs will have 15 questions. The candidate must strictly follow the official exam pattern only, as questions will be asked from the given syllabus.

faqs.question: What are some quick tips to prepare for the NIFT exam?
faqs.answer: Tips for NIFT exam preparation are given below. Check NIFT exam pattern and syllabus. Check the topics and plan accordingly Make sure you follow only the updated syllabus. Stay updated with trends, fashion shows, exhibitions, etc. Make a timetable taking into account the difficulty level of each topic. Solve sample papers and previous years' question papers. Practice mock tests.

faqs.question: What are the B.Des programs offered through NIFT 2026 exam?
faqs.answer: The NIFTs currently offers the following specializations at the B.Des level - Fashion Design, Leather Design, Accessory Design, Textile Design, Knitwear Design, and Fashion Communication. Admission to the above courses will be on the basis of NIFT 2025 scores. Currently, there are 18 participating institutes that offer a combined intake of 5,289 seats (including domestic and NRI/Foreign national seats). faqs.answer: The sample papers for the NIFT exam are released on the official website of the institute - nift.ac.in. The sample papers are available for the GAT and CAT written exams. Also, the sample papers are available for all the programs offered by the participating colleges - B. Des, M.Des M.FTech B.FTech and M. F. M. No login is required to download the sample papers. Simply click on the relevant sample paper. The sample papers are available in downloadable pdf format. It may be noted that the sample papers don't contain any solutions. Note that sample papers for NIFT 2026 will be released once the exam notification is out or sometime thereabout.

faqs.answer: NTA doesn't allow any objection window against the final key. This means, the keys included in the final key are final and officially the correct answers to questions asked in the GAT exam. The FINAL answer key of NIFT 2026 will be released tentatively in the last week of June 2026. The candidate can use the answers given in the final key to calculate the number of correct attempts and consequently the probable score. Note, the NTA will release the recorded responses and NIFT 2026 QP around the 3rd week of February 2026.

faqs.question: What is good score for NIFT 2026 B.F.Tech?
faqs.answer: Good score for B.F.Tech is 95+ for General,  80 for OBC,  60 for SC/ST. The final result will be declared in April 2026.

faqs.question: What is the syllabus for NIFT entrance exam?
faqs.answer: For B. Des and M.Des course admissions, candidates need to appear for CAT and GAT. NIFT Syllabus for CAT is such that candidates need to attempt drawing questions in the paper. Some topics that candidates should practice while preparing for the exam are design theory, creative thinking, and writing, elements and principles of design, principles of composition, etc. For GAT. Candidates should study topics such as quantitative ability, English  comprehension, logical reasoning, etc.

faqs.question: Can I carry my own material for the NIFT Situation Test?
faqs.answer: The NIFT Situation Test is a hands-on test that B. Des candidates need to appear in after qualifying the written exam. During the Situation Test the candidate has to make a model. Note that the material for making the model will be provided to the candidate inside the exam hall; no other material expect that provided to the candidate is allowed. So, candidates appearing in the Situation Test must not bring any additional materials for the Situation Test. The Situation Test will be evaluated on the spot. It is mandatory for the candidate to draft a write-up explaining the model.

faqs.question: How many questions are asked in NIFT GAT?
faqs.answer: The exam pattern for NIFT GAT varies from one course to another. The total number of questions asked in NIFT GAT is mentioned below: BDes: 100 questions, BFTech: 150 questions, MDes: 120 questions, MFTech: 150 questions, MFM: 150 questions. Note that the GAT or the General Ability Test will be conducted in a computer-based mode. Questions will be objective-type. The GAT paper for the B. Des and M.Des programs will be of 120 minutes. However, the GAT paper for the B.FTech, M.FTech, and MFM courses will be for 180 minutes.

faqs.question: What is the exam pattern for the NIFT CAT paper?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to the B. Des and M.Des course also need to take the Creative Ability Test CAT written exam, in addition to the GAT. The CAT exam will be conducted in an offline, pen-pencil mode. CAT will be a drawing-based exam of 3 hours duration. The CAT will evaluate various skills of the candidate including Intuition skill, power of observation, innovation in the development of a concept as well as design ability. Further, it will examine the creative as well as innovative use of color and illustration skills of aspirants. It is mandatory for B. Des and M.Des candidates to appear in the CAT paper, or else they will not be invited for the Situation Test.

faqs.question: What is NIFT exam pattern for the B.FTech program?
faqs.answer: The participating institutes of NIFTs offer a 4-year B.FTech programme. Admission to the programme is based on GAT scores. The NIFT GAT question paper for the programme will be approximately 180 minutes and will be bilingual. Candidates will have the option to take the exam either in English or Hindi. The question type will be multiple-choice. The question paper will have a total of 150 questions. Questions will be asked from the following FIVE sections - Communication Ability and Comprehension, Case Study, Quantitative Ability, Analytical & Logical Ability, and GK and Current Affairs. The mode of NIFT exam for the GAT paper will be a computer-based test (or CBT).

faqs.question: Which is more difficult, NIFT or UCEED?
faqs.answer: NIFT and UCEED are equally tough. NIFT has more levels or stage where as UCEED has only one level. UCEED focuses more on Graphic design, Product Design, etc., whereas NIFT focuses on Fashion design, Textile design, etc. The difficulty level of the exam depends on the preparation of the candidates.

faqs.question: What is the right time to solve sample papers for the NIFT entrance exam?
faqs.answer: It is recommended that the candidate make NIFT sample papers a part of their exam preparation strategy from the very beginning. For one, it will help the candidate evaluate their progress, hone their problem solving skills, and get a taste of the types of questions that will be asked in the entrance exam. Since at the start, most of the NIFT syllabus will be untouched, the candidate may focus on the topic they are preparing at that moment. In addition to the sample papers, the candidate must also keep solving the problem Sets given at the end of the chapter or end of the book. It is also important that the candidate keeps a close tab on the exam pattern and syllabus when solving the sample papers.

faqs.question: Do I need to create an applicant account to download NIFT sample papers?
faqs.answer: National Institute of Design releases sample papers of NIFT on its admission portal. These sample papers are available for all the UG and PG courses offered by NIFT participating institutes. To download sample papers, candidate simply needs to click on the sample paper they want to download. There is no need to create an applicant account or provide any other applicant details to download the sample papers. However, if the candidate wishes to download sample papers published by coaching institutes, he or she may be required to create an account. Further, the candidate, in most cases, has to pay a fee to use the sample papers.

faqs.question: How many sample papers do I need to prepare for NIFT?
faqs.answer: For NIFT Preparation, candidates need to solve 30-40 sample papers in 6 months. When the exams are very near, one sample paper should be solved daily.

faqs.question: When will NTA release NIFT 2026 Question Paper for Stage 1?
faqs.answer: NTA will be releasing the NIFT 2026 Question Paper for Stage 1 along with the provisional Answer Key. Candidates will be able to download the question paper by logging into NIFT portal.

faqs.question: Is the NIFT cut-off fixed?
faqs.answer: The cut-off of NIFT for the various academic courses is not fixed. This is because the cut-off depends on variables like seat intake, the performance of applicants in the NIFT exam, total number of applications received for admission, etc. Now these variables may change from year to year. For instance, the number of candidates appearing in NIFT and qualifying the exam may be different across the years. And when that happens, the cut-off also changes. Typically, if the seat intake increases, the cut-off goes down and vice versa. Likewise, if the number of applicants increases, expect a higher cut-off.

faqs.question: Which is more difficult, NIFT or NID DAT?
faqs.answer: NIFT and NID are equally tough. NIFT has two stages: NIFT Written exam and NIFT Situation Test and Personal Interview, whereas NID DAT also has two stages: NID DAT Prelims and NID Mains, which include Studio test and Personal Interview. Candidate who is preparing for NIFT can give NID DAT entrance exam with the same preparation. Practice and consistency in required for both exams.

faqs.question: Is the NIFT cut-off higher for top institutes such as NIFT Delhi?
faqs.answer: NIFT Delhi is frequently ranked among the top design colleges in the country. So, the admission cut-off for the institute is pretty high, especially when compared to the lower ranked colleges. This is because being a higher ranked college, NIFT Delhi receives a higher number of applicants. Another factor is more number of higher ranked candidates want to get admission in the institute, which also pushes up the cut-off. On the other hand, lower ranked colleges are not a priority for the top ranked candidates; meaning a higher number of lower ranked candidates applies to these institutes. This keeps the cut-off low in these institutes.

faqs.question: When do I need to start my preparation for NIFT 2026 exam?
faqs.answer: The NIFT exam is among the competitive and is also considered among the toughest. So, it is recommended that the candidate starts their exam preparation early. NIFT exam has various components like written exam and Situation Test /Personal Interview. Candidates seeking admission to the B. Des and M.Des courses need to prepare for both the CAT and GAT. The CAT is a drawing-based exam. Now unless the candidate is already well-versed, the exam will be very difficult. So, start early. The same goes for the GAT.

faqs.question: When and where will officials verify original documents for NIFT admission?
faqs.answer: The information provided by the candidate when filling out the NIFT 2026 application form are verified by NIFT officials before any candidate is considered for admission in the first week of June. The verification of original documents is conducted online. Note that at the time of counseling registration, the candidate is required to upload documents. Also, if the certificates are in any other language than Hindi/ English, then a certified translation in Hindi/ English produced duly verified by the issuing institution/ gazetted officer. If the candidate fails to produce the translation, the candidate may be denied admission.

faqs.question: What are the parameters that will be tested during NIFT 2026 Personal Interview (PI)?
faqs.answer: PG candidates will be evaluated on the various parameters as listed below by a panel, in the Personal Interview: Career orientation Aptness for the course Overall personal achievements in academics and co-curricular activities Communication General awareness, aptitude, creative and lateral thinking Candidates will be shortlisted for the PI based on their performance in the written exam - GAT (and CAT in case of M.Des program). Please note that NIFT reserves the right to modify the entrance examination scheme. This includes non-conduct of any stage (s) due to unforeseen circumstances.

faqs.answer: The NIFT exam includes two stages - The candidate first appears in the written exams, and if shortlisted has to next appear in a Situation Test/ Personal Interview (PI). Note that the written exams for the B.Des and M.Des program includes the GAT and CAT, whereas for the other programs the written exam includes only the GAT. The final score for the B. In case of the B.FTech programme, the merit list will be prepared based on GAT scores. faqs.question: Will NTA alter information entered by the candidate in NIFT application form?
faqs.answer: The NTA will not edit/ modify/ alter any information entered by the candidate under any circumstances. It will also not entertain requests for change in information. So, you must exercise utmost caution when filling up the form. Request for corrections made by any candidates through Post/Fax/ WhatsApp/ Email/ by hand will not be entertained by NTA.

faqs.question: How will the NIFT 2026 answer key be prepared?
faqs.answer: The role of the NTA is confined to registration of candidates and the conduct of the NIFT 2026 exam. The finalization of NIFT 2026 answer keys after inviting challenges, processing and declaration of results and preparation of the list of qualified candidates will be done by NTA in collaboration with the National Institute of Fashion Technology. Note that the NIFT answer key will only be released for the GAT paper. No key will be released for the offline-based GAT paper.

faqs.question: Will unfilled seats in OBC, EWS, categories during NIFT counseling be converted to open category?
faqs.answer: In case there unfilled seats in the OBC (NCL), EWS and domicile (Open) and domicile (OBC NCL) category, these seats will be converted to open category after a minimum of two rounds of seat allocation. The candidate has to select their category at the time of filling out the NIFT application form. Also, the candidate must ensure that they have the requisite valid and verificable certificate for the category chosen. If the candidate fails to submit proper documents, he or she will be considered under open category. Also

faqs.question: What is the reservation process for the NIFT entrance exam?
faqs.answer: The National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFTs) will follow the following reservation criteria: Category Reservation (%) SC 15 ST 7.5 OBC-NCL 27 GEN-EWS 10 PwD 5 The candidate has to select their category of admission at the time of filling out the application form and attach supporting documents. The admission officials will verify all relevant documents at the time of counseling.

faqs.question: Will my candidature for NIFT 2026 be cancelled if I select the wrong admission category?
faqs.answer: The candidate has to select their admission category at the time of filling out the NIFT 2026 application form. The candidate must make sure that they have the requisite valid and verificable certificate supporting their category. Note that the category selected by a candidate at the time of submitting the application form will be considered as final. If a candidate selects a reserved category i.e. SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PWD but fails to submitted a valid Category Certificate, he or she will be considered for open category seats provided any benefit of relaxed age or income or cut offs has not been availed by the candidate at any stage of the Admission Process. If any benefit has been availed, the candidate’s application will be rejected. Also, if a reserve category candidate is considered for open category, then he/she will have to pay the difference in amount of application fee as applicable for open category.

faqs.question: When and where will officials verify original documents for NIFT 2026 admission?
faqs.answer: The information provided by the candidate when filling out the NIFT 2026 application form will be verified by NIFT officials before any candidate is considered for admission. The verification of original documents will be conducted at the campus when the candidate reports for the alloted regular programme. When reporting for verification, along with the original documents, the candidate must also bring with them self-attested photocopies. Also, if the certificates are in any other language than Hindi/ English, then a certified translation in Hindi/ English produced duly verified by the issuing institution/ gazetted officer. If the candidate fails to produce the translation, the candidate may be denied admission.

faqs.question: Will there be an option to edit the NIFT application form?
faqs.answer: Candidates were given the option to edit the NIFT 2026 application form for a limited time period. Using NIFT application edit option, candidate will be able to edit or correct some of the information in registration form. Some of the details the candidate can edit include name, date of birth, category, state domicile, etc. However, the candidate is not allowed to edit the exam city. The schedule for the application correction will be notified by the National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT) at its admission portal - niftadmissions.in.

faqs.question: What are the documents needed and prescribed format to apply for NIFT 2026?
faqs.answer: When filling NIFT 2026 application form, you will have to upload your Live photo, photograph and signature. Check out details given below. Photograph - Upload only a recent scanned passport size color photograph. Accepted file size should be no more than 100KB. The accepted format is jpeg only. Signature - Scanned signature should be in Blue/Black ink on white background.

faqs.question: Can I appear in Situation Test/PI if I don't qualify the NIFT written exams?
faqs.answer: The Situation Test/ Personal Interview (PI) are the 2nd stage of the NIFT 2026 entrance exam. Candidates were shortlisted for the Situation Test/ PI based on the NIFT 2026 written exam scores . Note that if the candidate fails to qualify for the 2nd stage, he or she is not considered for admission to various design courses offered by the NIFTs. The only exception is B.F.Tech program, where the merit list for admission will be prepared solely on the basis of GAT scores. In the case of other courses, the merit list will be prepared by giving weightage to the written exams and Situation Test/ PI.

faqs.question: When do I need to start my preparation for NIFT 2026 exam?
faqs.answer: The NIFT exam is among the competitive and is also considered among the toughest. So, it is recommended that the candidate starts their exam preparation early. NIFT exam has various components like written exam and Situation Test /Personal Interview. Candidates seeking admission to the B. Des and M.Des courses need to prepare for both the CAT and GAT. The CAT is a drawing-based exam. Now unless the candidate is already well-versed, the exam will be very difficult. So, start early. The same goes for the GAT.

faqs.question: Can I challenge the NIFT 2026 answer key?
faqs.answer: Yes, the candidate is allowed to challenge the draft version of the NIFT 2026 answer key. Objections cannot be filed against the the final answer key. The provisional answer key will be released in February 2026; note that the NIFT written exam will be conducted around the 1st week of February 2026. The answer key contains the official keys to all the questions asked in the exam. Objections against the NIFT 2026 answer key has to filed online through the candidate portal. To file objections, the candidate had to pay a fee of INR 500 per objection.

faqs.question: Will NTA share information entered by candidates during NIFT application submission with 3rd party?
faqs.answer: NTA/NIFT /Government of India can use the data provided by candidate for internal purpose(s) including training, research and development, analysis and other permissible purpose(s). However, this information will not be shared with any third party or private agency for any other use.

faqs.question: What is NIFT lateral entry admission (NLEA) scheme?
faqs.answer: NIFT Lateral Entry Admission (NLEA) provides an opportunity to candidates who have completed their Diploma in relevant or related fields of Design & Technology for direct admission to the third semester of UG programmes of NIFT. Eligible candidates have to appear in the NIFT 2026 entrance exam to get lateral admission. Admission under lateral entry scheme will be strictly on merit of NIFT 2026 exam, which will include written examination, studio test/ technology aptitude test, and a personal interview. Candidates selected through lateral entry will join the regular UG students of NIFT in their second year. The seat intake under this scheme will be displayed on the website prior to seat allocation.

faqs.question: How will NTA communicate important information about NIFT exam?
faqs.answer: Important or relevant information about the NIFT 2026 exam will be sent by NTA through e-mail on the registered e-mail address and/or through SMS on registered mobile number only. Also, the NTA will not be responsible for any non-communication/ miscommunication with a candidate in the email address or mobile number given by him/her other than his/her own.

faqs.question: At what time do I need to report for the NIFT 2026 written exam?
faqs.answer: The GAT paper for all the B.Des and M.Des courses will be conducted from 9 am - 11 am (tentatively). Meanwhile, the GAT written exam for B.F.Tech, M.F.Tech, and M.F.M. courses are expected to be conducted from 9 am - 12 noon. Candidates needed to report to the NIFT 2026 exam centre at least an hour in advance. Note that the CAT paper for the B. Des and M.Des courses will be held from 2.30 pm - 5.30 pm. The purpose of reporting early is to complete admission formalities, including registration, frisking, verifying the identity of the candidate, etc. Note that the exam timings and reporting time for the NIFT exam will be mentioned in the admit card.

faqs.question: Who can apply for NIFT 2026 under Persons with Disability (PwD) category?
faqs.answer: As per Section 2(t) of the RPwD Act, “Persons with Disability (PwD)” means a person with long-term physical, mental, intellectual, or sensory impairment which, in interaction with barriers, hinders his full and effective participation in society equally with others.

faqs.question: When will NIFT cutoff be released?
faqs.answer: The National Instituite of Fashion Technology will release the NIFT 2026 at the time of seat allotment and counseling. The cut-offs will be available institute and category-wise for all the program at nift.admissions.nic.in. The cut-offs will be prepared by considering factors like the seat intake, the merit rank of candidates, admission category, etc. Note that if the seat intake is increase the cut-off would likely go down and vice versa. The cut-offs are available for the following titles: Opening and Closing Rank Details for NIFT UG Counselling 2026 Opening and Closing Rank Details for NIFT UG (Lateral Entry) Counselling 2026 Opening and Closing Rank Details for NIFT PG Counselling 2026 To download the cut-offs, visit: https://nift.admissions.nic.in/or-cr/

faqs.question: What is good score for NIFT 2026 B.F.Tech?
faqs.answer: Good score for B.F.Tech is 95+ for General,  80 for OBC,  60 for SC/ST. The final result will be declared in April 2026.

faqs.question: What are NIFT Score accepting colleges other than participating colleges?
faqs.answer: There are 19 NIFTs that will accept NIFT 2026 Scores for admission purposes. These institutes are known as participating colleges. However, in addition to the participating colleges, there are other private colleges that will also consider NIFT 2026 scores for admission to their UG and PG design courses. The candidates are urged to go through the list of result-sharing institutes.
